message: The astro target does not support directive: A directive's hooks never run on Astro: components render on the server only, and nothing runs in the browser.
The ember target does not support directive: Directives are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The ember target does not support component: Child components, slots, models, context and the built-in components are not emitted yet. See uxfront-com/unframework#236.
The astro target does not support directive: A directive's hooks never run on Astro: components render on the server only, and nothing runs in the browser.
